# montecarlo_generic_collection_agent_oauth_client (Data Source)

An OAuth client is an OAuth 2.0 client id and secret a generic collection agent uses to authenticate to Monte Carlo. The secret is returned only when the client is created. A deployment can hold several clients, so create the new one before deleting the old one when rotating.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Id of the token or OAuth client, as returned when it is created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Client id the agent presents, as `client_id` in its configuration. The same value as `id`.
- `created_time` (String) When the credential was created.
- `deployment_id` (String) Identifier of the deployment whose agent presents this credential.
- `description` (String) What this credential is for.
- `expiration_time` (String) When the client stops being accepted. Null for a client that does not expire.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credential. For a token this is also its key id; for an OAuth client, its client id.
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth scopes the client is granted.
- `type` (String) Which kind of credential this is.
